objective: GATE 3F-B-R1 MPRO. Certificar de forma minima y determinista si existe evidencia runtime suficiente para considerar autoritativo el mecanismo de Pc_ID. Reusar solo consultas simples ya aprobadas en 3F-A R2: metadata de Pc_ID, distribucion observada, PK compuesta y ausencia/presencia de sequences. Si no aparece generador autoritativo, certificar BLOCKED_NOT_READY para canary MPRO. No escribir ni implementar Payment Executor.

queries.name: f3b_r1_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: f3b_r1_pc_id_column
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,c.is_computed,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') AND c.name=N'Pc_ID'

queries.name: f3b_r1_pc_id_frequency
queries.sql: SELECT Pc_ID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Pc_ID ORDER BY total DESC,Pc_ID

queries.name: f3b_r1_pk_shape
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i INNER JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') AND i.is_primary_key=1 ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: f3b_r1_sequences
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,q.name AS sequence_name,q.current_value FROM sys.sequences q INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=q.schema_id WHERE q.name LIKE N'%Pago%' OR q.name LIKE N'%CXP%' OR q.name LIKE N'%Pc%' ORDER BY s.name,q.name

constraints: NO INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE EXEC EXECUTE DDL SELECT INTO OR MULTI-STATEMENT SQL
NO individual provider, invoice or payment business rows beyond bounded Pc_ID code frequency
Connections only through PosRuntimeResolver and get_external_sql_connection
Historical frequency does not prove authoritative generation
If no authoritative generator is proven, classify Pc_ID authority as NOT_PROVEN and MPRO canary as BLOCKED_NOT_READY
Do not authorize any canary or Payment Executor writer
